header: Praxisstart — everything a changeover needs, in one price
lead: Moving a practice off its old system is four jobs, not one. Booked together they cost less than booked one at a time, and they are scheduled as a single week rather than four separate appointments.
note: Booked with any plan, payable after the changeover week. Prices are net. The bundle can be booked once per practice.

contents.title: Data migration from your current system
contents.text: Patients, appointments, open invoices and scanned documents, checked against your own record count before go-live.

contents.title: Half-day remote training
contents.text: For the whole team at once, recorded so anyone on holiday that week can watch it later.

contents.title: Card-terminal configuration
contents.text: One terminal connected and tested with a real payment on the day.

contents.title: Online booking, first three months
contents.text: Switched on during the changeover so patients notice the new system before the practice does.
